title: Unreal Tournament/Walkthrough
text:
General strategy
 Get a big gun.
 Run about.
 When you see something that moves, jump and shoot.

Specific strategies
Rocket Launcher
As you run around, start charging up the rocket launcher. Then when you see something move, jump and unleash 3–5 rockets into them. You barely need to aim. Works best on smaller maps.

Shock Rifle
Fire off a shock ball (secondary fire), then hit the shock ball with a normal shock rifle beam (primary fire). The shock ball will explode into a big glowing ball of death. Useful if someone is hiding behind a corner.
